metadata.name: bills
metadata.comment: Business-facing bills view. One row per current MYOB AP bill line. Enriched with supplier name, class, and ABN; and MYOB project name, status, and branch. Use project_id + cost_code to match against project_margin_detail for drill-down reconciliation. estimated_allowance_value is the approved budget allowance for that cost code within the project. Exposed to Metabase and NLQ.

bill_status.name: bill_status
bill_status.comment: Current bill status in MYOB (e.g. Open, Closed).

is_open.name: is_open
is_open.comment: True if the bill is currently open (not yet fully paid).

vendor_id.name: vendor_id
vendor_id.comment: MYOB vendor identifier. Join to suppliers.vendor_id.

closed_date.name: closed_date
closed_date.comment: Date the bill was closed or paid. Null if still open.

pay_date.name: pay_date
pay_date.comment: Actual payment date. Null if unpaid.

post_period.name: post_period
post_period.comment: MYOB accounting period the bill was posted to.

project_id.name: project_id
project_id.comment: MYOB project this bill line is assigned to. Join to project_margins.project_id.

project_status.name: project_status
project_status.comment: Current status of the linked MYOB project.

project_branch.name: project_branch
project_branch.comment: MYOB branch of the linked project.

cost_code.name: cost_code
cost_code.comment: Cost code within the project. Matches cost_code in project_margin_detail.

balance.name: balance
balance.comment: Outstanding balance on this bill line in AUD.

estimated_allowance_value.name: estimated_allowance_value
estimated_allowance_value.comment: Budgeted/approved cost allowance for this project + cost code in AUD. Represents the contingency or trade allowance set on the project bill.

last_modified_on.name: last_modified_on
last_modified_on.comment: Timestamp of last modification in MYOB.

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table
